runs.t: A complete structural office building solution, the NetZERO Building Platform provides an efficient alternative to traditional buildings in both design and delivery models. With a focus on sustainability and occupant wellness, NetZERO responds to market concerns about how and where work will happen in the future.
How the prefabricated frame, radiant floor system and high-efficiency facade work together as one building platform.
CARBONSHIELD® is a unique and proprietary concrete mix developed by Clark Pacific that provides the same performance as traditional mixes and is standard in our structural products.
It replaces 25% of the portland cement in our concrete mixes, reducing embodied carbon by roughly 20%. Our goal is double this by 2030, through our continuous R&D efforts and material partnerships.

Reimagined and redesigned from the ground up with health and sustainability as priorities. Building owners no longer must sacrifice sustainability to meet the proforma. Offsite manufacturing delivers premium performance and design flexibility at lower cost.

Long-span structural grid adapts to any program requirement — office, lab, mixed-use — without costly structural modifications.
All-electric radiant floor system achieves 89% below baseline EUI — heating and cooling efficiencies double that of non-radiant systems.
Durable precast concrete structure with minimal mechanical complexity — lower operating costs over the building's full lifetime.
Factory-controlled production delivers consistent quality, reduced site impacts, and a compressed construction schedule.
CARBONSHIELD® standard in all structural products, plus all-electric mechanical — 40% less whole life carbon vs. conventional construction.

NetZERO maximizes its all-electric heat pump, resulting in heating and cooling efficiencies that are double what can be accomplished by non-radiant heat pump systems — while minimizing equipment needs and reducing demands on the grid.

Our radiant system uses 100% outside air — delivering 33% fewer allergy symptoms and 50% fewer asthma symptoms vs. recirculated air systems.
Individual zone control delivers optimal comfort for occupants across the floor plate — no more hot desks or cold corners.
Long spans and open floor plates maximize access to daylight for all occupants — a proven factor in productivity and well-being.
